General Knowledge 2015-I.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-I.question: Rise in the price of a commodity means
options: rise in the value of currency only
fall in the value of currency only
rise in the value of commodity only
fall in the value of currency and rise in the value of commodity.
General Knowledge 2015-I.answer: fall in the value of currency only
General Knowledge 2015-I.explanation: (b)  Rise in the price of a commodity means both fall in the value of currency and rise in the value of commodity.
